purpose: Automatically rank exercise substitutes without requiring manual exercise or equipment entry.
hardFilters: exercise equipment must be available at the selected location
exercise must not be excluded by a later user-specific restriction
exercise must have at least one primary muscle or movement-pattern match to the workout slot

homePullingLimitation.appliesWhen: selected location has only bodyweight and yoga_mat
homePullingLimitation.message: A true loaded lat/back pull may not be available with the confirmed home equipment. Zero2Fit may offer a lower-equivalence bodyweight movement for pattern practice, but it must label the limitation instead of pretending it is an equivalent lat-strength exercise.
